data.body: CLOSED: landed as change 1033 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1033), merged commit 457f99e29 on main with LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments. Fix: (1) impact-aware nit suppression in code_review_decide — docs/llm-prompts-only advisories dropped only at impact == 0, impact > 0 surfaces; (2) code-review-docs.md narrowed to both-sides-in-diff findings with explicit prohibition on absence speculation; (3) 8-test suite tests/unit/test_code_review_nit_suppression.py covering all three acceptance criteria. Bug class: preexisting (design defect in the original blanket suppression, not a regression).
